### Seed Stories
Author: Mike DeVries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/seed-stories-homeword-june-27.html
Passage: Luke 8:15
Points:
- Jesus used everyday agricultural stories to draw listeners in and expand their understanding of God.
- The good soil represents those who welcome God's teaching and let it take root in their lives.
- Retaining the Word means being held and transformed by it rather than treating Scripture as detached knowledge.
- Real spiritual growth happens when believers enter into a living relationship with God's message.

### The Parable of the Sower
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/parable-sower
Passage: Mark 4:1-9
Points:
- Jesus taught from a boat on the Sea of Galilee so the surrounding crowd could see and hear Him clearly.
- Scattering seed across every type of ground illustrates the indiscriminate sharing of the gospel with all people.
- Believers are charged to preach the message faithfully, trusting God alone to prepare human hearts.
- Christ's call to listen contrasts the outward proclamation of the Word with the inner gift of saving faith.
